description: Odds and Ends: A collection of small UX improvements to tighten up the app. Includes chart refresh for candlestick mode, multi-ticker watchlist operations, command mode for escaping input focus, and page navigation in options panel.
principles: STABILITY AND PERFORMANCE ARE PARAMOUNT - Recent gains must be preserved
Rock-solid quality over speed - every change must be bulletproof
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
Minimal changes - surgical fixes, not rewrites
No regressions - existing functionality must remain intact
If in doubt, keep it simple

userStories.title: Configurable chart refresh for candlestick mode
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'chart_refresh_interval' to Config dataclass (default: 30 seconds)
Add validation: must be positive integer, 0 disables refresh
When chart is in candlestick mode, trigger re-render at configured interval
Re-render uses existing cached data (watchlist already refreshes data)
No new API calls - just re-render with latest cached price data
Refresh timer only active when candlestick mode is enabled AND interval > 0
Timer resets on manual timeframe change or style toggle
No visual flicker during refresh - smooth update
Update README.md with new config option documentation
Test: refresh triggers at correct interval
Test: refresh uses cached data, no network calls
Test: timer stops when switching away from candlestick
Test: interval=0 disables refresh
Test: config validation handles invalid values
userStories.notes: Watchlist already refreshes data periodically. This just ensures the chart visual updates to reflect that refreshed data. Configurable interval allows users to tune for their needs or disable entirely.

userStories.title: Multi-ticker watchlist add/delete with space-delimited input
acceptanceCriteria: Add command accepts space-delimited tickers: 'w AAPL MSFT GOOGL BTC-USD'
Delete command accepts space-delimited tickers: 'd AAPL MSFT'
All valid tickers in input are processed in single operation
Invalid tickers show error but valid ones still get processed
No mixing add/delete in same command - prefix determines operation
Existing single-ticker behavior remains unchanged: 'w AAPL' still works
Clear feedback on what was added/removed: 'Added: AAPL, MSFT. Failed: INVALID'
Handles tickers with dashes correctly (BTC-USD, ETH-USD)
Test: 'w AAPL MSFT GOOGL' adds all three
Test: 'd AAPL MSFT' removes both
Test: partial success (some valid, some invalid)
Test: single ticker still works as before
Test: tickers with dashes handled correctly
userStories.notes: Quality-of-life improvement for managing watchlists. Keep existing w/d prefix pattern - just allow multiple tickers after the command. No '-TICKER' syntax to avoid confusion with tickers like BTC-USD.

userStories.title: Command mode - global key to exit input focus
acceptanceCriteria: Escape key exits input bar focus when input bar has focus
After exiting input focus, chart/news/options keybindings become active
User can access 'o' (options), 'n' (news), 'v' (chart toggle) without tabbing
Status bar or visual indicator shows current mode (input vs command)
Tab still works for panel navigation as before
Pressing '/' re-enters input/search mode
No disruption to existing tab-based navigation
No conflict with news panel Escape (different focus context)
Test: Escape exits input focus correctly
Test: global keys work after exiting input mode
Test: '/' returns to input mode
Test: existing Tab navigation unaffected
Test: news panel Escape (reader -> listing) still works
userStories.notes: Currently after submitting to watchlist, user is stuck in input mode and must Tab to another panel before using chart/news/options keys. Escape is context-dependent: in input bar it exits to command mode, in news reader it goes back to listing. No conflict since different widgets handle their own focus.

userStories.title: Page Up/Down navigation in options panel
acceptanceCriteria: PgUp/PgDn keybindings in options panel for fast navigation
Page size: jump 10 items (or visible page height) at a time
j/k single-item navigation continues to work
Bounds checking: don't scroll past first/last item
Selection highlight follows after page jump
Update help_screen.py with PgUp/PgDn documentation
Test: PgUp moves up correct number of items
Test: PgDn moves down correct number of items
Test: bounds checking at top and bottom
Test: j/k still work as before
userStories.notes: Options strike lists can be very long. Single-item navigation with j/k is tedious. Page-based navigation is standard in list UIs.

chartRefresh.dataSource: Use existing cached HistoricalData - no new fetches

User can add multiple tickers: 'w AAPL MSFT GOOGL BTC-USD'
User can delete multiple tickers: 'd AAPL MSFT'
Escape key exits input mode, enabling chart/news/options keys
All existing functionality continues to work
